Bash(sudo python3 -c "
from scapy.all import rdpcap, UDP, IP
pkts = rdpcap\('/tmp/gtp_live.pcap'\)
for p in pkts:
    if UDP in p and p[UDP].dport == 2152 and p[IP].src == '10.201.0.2':
        payload = bytes\(p[UDP].payload\)
        print\('GTP-U header + opt + ext header bytes:'\)
        print\('  flags=0x%02x msg=0x%02x len=%d teid=0x%08x' % \(
            payload[0], payload[1],
            int.from_bytes\(payload[2:4],'big'\),
            int.from_bytes\(payload[4:8],'big'\)\)\)
        print\('  opt: seq=%d n_pdu=%d next_ext=0x%02x' % \(
            int.from_bytes\(payload[8:10],'big'\), payload[10], payload[11]\)\)
        print\('  ext[0]: len_units=%d content=0x%02x%02x next=0x%02x' % \(
            payload[12], payload[13], payload[14], payload[15]\)\)
        print\('  inner IP starts at byte 16: version=%d' % \(payload[16] >> 4\)\)
        break
" 2>/dev/null)
